$comment: IA icerik catisi — JabLab library.json desenini uyarlar (M-F-103/108).
Kutuphane -> Calgi sayfasi -> Kurs -> Ders. Her calgi KENDI sayfasi.
DURUSTLUK KURALLARI (mekanik olarak test edilir, tools/validate_library.py):
1. status=coming_soon olan calgida KURS OLAMAZ (sahte kurs listelenmez).
2. Her kursun en az 1 dersi olmak zorunda (bos kurs listelenmez).
3. Ders, ruleset'te BULUNMAYAN teknige atif yapamaz.
4. Her calgida honesty bloku ZORUNLU (neler olculur / neler OLCULMEZ).
5. status=locked olan her ders lockedReason tasimak zorunda (esik degeri DEGIL, EKSIK OLCUMUN adi).
6. Kapsam-disi (comingSoonInThisDiscipline) her madde gerekce tasimak zorunda.

disciplines.blurb: Put your phone where it can see you sitting with your guitar. We check your sitting posture against how real teachers sit, and listen for the chords you play.

measured: Trunk alignment while sitting (checked against 3 independent guitar teachers, M-O-47/48)
Chord class for 8 open chords — E A D G C Am Em Dm (kromagram/template matching, M-O-35)
notMeasured: Arm and hand position while holding the guitar — teachers disagree about this by style (11-18 degrees apart), we show it but do not grade it (M-O-46)
Finger placement or fretting technique — camera cannot see fingers well enough to grade them yet
Strum timing quality judgement — measured, not yet graded (expertPending)
Full note-by-note transcription — we recognise the chord class, not every note played

courses.goal: Sit correctly and learn to hear when you're playing the right open chord.

lessons._why_unlocked: trunk_tilt referansi ATTESTED (3 bagimsiz egitmen, M-O-47) ve tuketicisi CANLI oldugu kanitlandi (M-O-48) — bu ders yalniz o olcumu kullanir, chord_correctness'a bagli DEGIL.

lessons.lockedReason: Chord recognition has only been proven on synthetic audio (8/8 chords, zero false judgements) — it hasn't been tested on a real guitar recording yet. We won't grade you against a measurement we haven't confirmed on a real instrument.

comingSoonInThisDiscipline: Strum timing as a graded skill — measured but not yet gated (expertPending, quality bar unset)
Arm/hand posture as a graded skill — teachers disagree by style, this may never become gradeable (see honesty box)

disciplines.blurb: Sing along and get feedback on pitch, sustain and posture.
disciplines.comingSoonReason: Posture reference needs 3 independent teachers agreeing on a real hold-window; current pool has 1 usable window (M-F-95 cooldown, material-class question open — singers stand and move, a 'hold' may not be the right target, see presence-window spec).

notMeasured: Everything — nothing is live yet. Pitch and periodicity motors exist (ostinato_audio, engine status) but no posture reference has passed the agreement gate.

disciplines.blurb: Practice five-finger patterns and chords with posture and hand feedback.
